items.exampleEn: The two pieces are joined magnetically, so they come apart easily.
items.exampleZh: 這兩塊是用磁力接在一起的，所以很容易分開。

items.exampleEn: Contextually, the joke made sense, but alone it sounded rude.
items.exampleZh: 放在情境裡，那個笑話說得通，但單獨聽起來很失禮。
items.glossZh: 就情境而言；根據上下文

items.exampleEn: In this flower, the white color is a recessive feature.
items.exampleZh: 在這種花身上，白色是一種隱性的特徵。

items.exampleEn: This room was designed acoustically for recording music.
items.exampleZh: 這個房間在聲學上是為錄音而設計的。

items.exampleEn: In grammar, an interjection shows a sudden feeling, such as surprise.
items.exampleZh: 在文法上，感嘆詞表達突然的情緒，例如驚訝。

items.exampleEn: The concert hall is famous for its excellent acoustics.
items.exampleZh: 這座音樂廳以絕佳的音響效果聞名。

items.exampleEn: The course teaches the rudiments of photography.

items.sentenceEn: Red hair is caused by a recessive gene.
items.sentenceZh: 紅頭髮是由隱性基因造成的。

items.audioEn: Thanks to the new walls, the room is acoustically much better than before.
items.audioZh: 多虧了新牆，這個房間的音響效果比以前好多了。
options: It is much bigger than before.

items.sentenceEn: I learned the rudiments of cooking from my father.
items.sentenceZh: 我是跟爸爸學會烹飪基礎的。

items.sentenceEn: The doors close magnetically when the alarm sounds.
items.sentenceZh: 警報一響，門就會靠磁力自動關上。

items.stemEn: The ____ in this theater are so good that you can hear a whisper from the back row.
items.stemZh: 這間劇場的音響效果好到在最後一排都聽得到耳語。

items.stemEn: Words can often be understood ____, from the sentences around them.
items.stemZh: 字詞常常可以從周圍的句子，根據上下文來理解。

items.passageEn: When Ana joined a community choir, she knew only the rudiments of music. The choir practices in an old town hall, and its acoustics are wonderful: even quiet voices fill the whole room. The director, a cheerful former teacher, often stops the singing with a short interjection such as "Again, softer!" Ana found that the words of the songs made more sense when she read them contextually, as part of the whole story. She has also learned to trust her intuition when she sings. Now she feels magnetically drawn to the Thursday practices and never misses one. "Acoustically, singing there is a dream," she says.
items.passageZh: Ana 加入地方上的合唱團時，只懂音樂的基礎。合唱團在一座老舊的市民會堂練習，那裡的音響效果非常好：就連輕聲唱歌也能填滿整個空間。指揮是一位開朗、以前當過老師的人，常常用一句簡短的插話打斷大家，例如「再一次，小聲一點！」Ana 發現，把歌詞放在整個故事的脈絡裡讀，就更容易理解。她也學會在唱歌時相信自己的直覺。現在，她被每週四的練唱深深吸引，從不缺席。她說：「在那裡唱歌，音響效果簡直像做夢一樣。」

questions.questionZh: Ana 剛加入時，音樂程度如何？
合唱團練習的地方有什麼特色？

referenceEn: I only know the rudiments of playing the piano.
I know just the rudiments of the piano.
rubricZh: the rudiments of＋名詞或動名詞表示「⋯的基礎」（例如 the rudiments of playing the piano 等）
「只懂」可寫，例如 only know、know just 等

items.promptZh: 主持人的一句插話，讓整個討論輕鬆了起來。
referenceEn: The host's interjection made the whole discussion more relaxed.
One interjection from the host made the whole discussion lighter.
rubricZh: 「插話」用名詞 interjection（例如 the host's interjection 等）
「輕鬆了起來」可寫，例如 more relaxed、lighter、less serious 等
時態配合內容（例如 made 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: former teacher 改譯「以前當過老師」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：characterization、demographically 再次當干擾項（跨課重複），且詞性與副詞空格不同
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: characterization、demographically 換成 magnetically、geologically（副詞，放得進空格但語意不通），保留 recessive

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（App 單字卡只顯示釋義第一義）：contextually 釋義第一義「根據上下文」不是例句示範的詞義

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（App 單字卡只顯示釋義第一義）：interjection 釋義第一義「插話」不是例句示範的詞義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改為「感嘆詞；插話」，雙義配對的干擾項同步對調

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：acoustics 例句「She studied acoustics at university because she loves music.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「音響效果」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「The concert hall is famous for its excellent acoustics.」示範第一義；釋義為「音響效果；聲學」
